headline: CardinalStone Leads Listing of ₦728.98 Billion Power Sector Bonds on NGX and FMDQ
summary: CardinalStone Partners led the landmark listing of ₦728.98 billion in power sector bonds on the Nigerian Exchange and FMDQ, marking a milestone in debt reduction.
why: The Presidential Power Sector Debt Reduction Programme uses debt instruments to restructure liabilities in Nigeria's crucial energy infrastructure.

impacts.name: Power Sector Bonds
impacts.why: A large volume of sector bonds was listed across domestic exchanges.
